remarks: RARELY ON THE MARKET IN OLD TOWN SEAL BEACH! This charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath beach condo offers 840 square feet of inviting living space and an incredible opportunity to enjoy the Seal Beach lifestyle. Remodeled in 2024, the home is tucked privately at the rear of an intimate two-unit property, with all living space conveniently located on the second level. The property includes a two-car tandem garage with laundry in the garage, providing valuable parking and storage in this highly desirable beach community.
